text:
sophia: Heads-up: planning an incremental onboarding runway for 3 legacy tenants next sprint. Need to agree on the micro-bench, pin semantics, and an ops escape hatch.
owen: Proposal: 8 prompts per tenant, p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and a quick qualitative smoke (1 human pass). Keep the suite <2 minutes per model.
lina (eng-runtime): Technically doable. We should include a streaming vs non-streaming toggle so results match customer integration. Also need a per-tenant flag to opt-out of auto-fallback for enterprise contracts.
sophia: Agree on opt-out. For metrics, threshold rules: p95 <= baseline*1.2, token-cost delta <= 15%, qual delta <= 3% top-1. Failures trigger canary hold.
own: Bench script example:
```
./run_onboard_bench --tenant tenant-42 --samples 8 --mode streaming --metrics latency,p95,cost,qual --out s3://bench-results/tenant-42.json
```
own: We should warm KV cache before sampling to simulate production. Add a "warm-seq" step.
lina (eng-runtime): I'll add cache-warm and embed-schema check. If embedding schema mismatch, bench marks as "blocked" and pings SE.
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: onboard-canary-176777 at 2025-10-01T09:00Z (CI: https://ci.redwood/onboard/176777).
carlos (pm): Rollout plan: 1) internal QA (team), 2) tenant-42 & tenant-77 (low traffic), 3) up to 3 tenants. Each wave: bench pass + 12h observation with error-rate < 2% and no increased latency traces.
sophia: About pin editing: expose /admin/catalog/pin with audit trail and a TTL. Default TTL = 30 days for soft pin; auto-rollback to platform-default variant after TTL or on-failure.
lina (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: add a fallback policy that can be parameterized per-tenant: {"on_error": "fallback_variant", "on_high_error": "pause_traffic"}. I'll draft the config keys.
own: Ops: add an uploader that posts bench results to the onboarding dashboard and tags failures. I'll sketch the uploader by Wed.
sophia: Customer ask: one tenant asked for a 45-day pinned grace with reduced SLA. We need legal to approve and finance to calculate discounted rates. I'll loop them in.
carlos (pm): Action items: lina -> pin API + embed-check spec by Tue EOD; owen -> bench + uploader by Wed noon; sophia -> customer comms + legal loop by Wed EOD. I'll create the tracker ticket and owner tags.
ops-bot: Note: bench threshold config is at infra repo -> /configs/onboard/bench-criteria.yaml
sophia: Quick comm line: "We will perform a brief bench and 12h observation before any cutover. If benchmarks fail, we'll pause the rollout and schedule a follow-up with your SE." Keep it short.
lina (eng-runtime): One caution: when warming KV cache, ensure we don't re-use sensitive customer prefixes in shared bench infra. Use anonymized prompts.
own: Good catch. We'll scrub PII in bench harness.
sophia: Meeting check-in Friday 10am to surface blockers. Thanks everyone :handshake:
